programmes.nameEn: Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical Engineering
programmes.descriptionEn: The Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical Engineering is a 4-year full-time joint undergraduate programme delivered in Singapore and awarded jointly by the Technical University of Munich and the Singapore Institute of Technology. The programme equips students with Industry 4.0 skills in chemical engineering, including data engineering, additive manufacturing, laboratory practice and advanced process technologies.

detailSections.bodyEn: The Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical Engineering is a 4-year full-time joint undergraduate programme delivered in Singapore and awarded jointly by the Technical University of Munich and the Singapore Institute of Technology. The programme equips students with Industry 4.0 skills in chemical engineering, including data engineering, additive manufacturing, laboratory practice and advanced process technologies.

Applicants to the Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical Engineering must meet the academic and English language requirements set by the Technical University of Munich and the Singapore Institute of Technology. Admission is assessed based on applicants’ academic background, relevant preparation in engineering disciplines, and supporting documentation. POLYTECHNIC DIPLOMAS Diploma holders from any of the five local polytechnics and A Level / IB Diploma graduates are welcome to apply. Applicants with Chemical Engineering or closely related Science and Technology diplomas are strongly encouraged to apply. Students with other qualifications (completed a formal 12-year education equivalent to A-Levels) are eligible to apply as well. Note: Incoming students are required to submit soft copies of the following documents for TUM’s online matriculation during their first year of study: PDF copy of valid passport (personal particulars page only) Recent passport size photo PDF copy of resume/CV PDF copy of the notarised Polytechnic/O and A-level/IB academic documents (final certificate and transcripts) PDF copy of SIT’s Admission Letter More details will be shared at the matriculation stage. SINGAPORE GCE A-LEVELS Applicants with the Singapore-Cambridge A-Level qualification must meet the following requirements: A total of 7 subjects. 4 Advanced Level subjects, including 3 subjects at H2 level, and 1 subject at H1 level. There must be at least 4 independent general education subjects obtained in the same sitting. Candidates must have taken at least 1 H2 mathematics and 1 H2 Science subject (Biology, Chemistry or Physics). Obtained a pass in General Paper (GP) of Knowledge & Inquiry (KI) in the same sitting, while satisfying Mother Tongue Language (MTL)* requirement. In general, applicants presenting Singapore-Cambridge A-Level results are not required to submit the A-Level certificate during the application. However, for the SIT-TUM programme, it is mandatory to submit the O-Level and A-Level transcripts during the application, and the transcripts, School Graduation Certificate, and other documents during matriculation. More details will be shared with incoming students. *GCE A-Level/IB Applicants need to fulfil the language requirements as stipulated by the German Higher Education System. *GCE A-Level applicants must have taken 2 language subjects, out of which 1 must be at H1level to fulfil the language requirements stipulated by the German Higher Education System. The same language taken at both A-Level and O-Level is not acceptable. If you have been exempted from taking MTL for your GCE A-Level, you can retake the subject to fulfil the language requirement. For further enquires on the langue requirements, please contact TUM Asia Admission Office at admission@tum-asia.edu.sg . Note: Incoming students are required to submit softcopies of the following documents for TUM’s online matriculation during their first year of study: PDF copy of valid passport (personal particular page only) Recent passport size photo PDF copy of resume/CV PDF copy of the notraised Polytechnic/O and A-level/IB academic documents (final certificate and transcripts) PDF copy of SIT’s Admission Letter More details will be shared at the matriculation stage. INTERNATIONAL GCE A-LEVELS Applicants must present at least three independent A-Level subjects with a minimum grade of C in each subject. Of these, 2 subjects must be chosen as follows: a language, history, geography, social studies/politics, economics, mathematics, biology, chemistry, physics, computer science according to “→List A: General-education A level subjects that meet the basic requirements” (subject 1 and subject 2, possibly subject 3) List A: https://www.daad.de/en/studying-in-germany/requirements/gce-list-a/ List B: https://www.daad.de/en/studying-in-germany/requirements/gce-list-b/ The third subject is a further general education subject, independent of the two subjects chosen above, this can come from

programmes.nameEn: Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Data Engineering
programmes.descriptionEn: The Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Data Engineering is a 4-year full-time joint undergraduate programme delivered in Singapore and awarded jointly by the Technical University of Munich and the Singapore Institute of Technology. The programme combines electronics and data engineering, equipping students with knowledge in semiconductor physics, circuit design, data science, machine learning, sensors, power electronics and advanced digital technologies for the electronics and semiconductor manufacturing sectors.

detailSections.bodyEn: The Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Data Engineering is a 4-year full-time joint undergraduate programme delivered in Singapore and awarded jointly by the Technical University of Munich and the Singapore Institute of Technology. The programme combines electronics and data engineering, equipping students with knowledge in semiconductor physics, circuit design, data science, machine learning, sensors, power electronics and advanced digital technologies for the electronics and semiconductor manufacturing sectors.
